headline: Retention improved after filtration; the customer pilot remains conditional.
interpretation: Filtered samples retain 93.6% capacity at the final checkpoint versus 89.2% in the untreated reference. The third formulation reaches 92.1%. These samples support a limited pilot, but differences in initial conditioning and unresolved moisture results prevent a causal attribution to filtration alone.
